name: predictalot
description: Self-hosted forecasting service — zero-shot time-series forecasting (chronos-2, timesfm-2.5, moirai-2, toto-1, sundial-base-128m) across univariate, multivariate, covariate, and sample-path types, plus supervised tabular ML (9 backends, 3 meta-learners) with train+persist and weighted ensembles. Unified REST + MCP (Streamable-HTTP at /mcp).
